protocol.calibration: one historical-train file per known identity plus one per historical unknown cluster
protocol.random_val: the untouched 891-file validation used before leaderboard submissions
protocol.hard: one disjoint, maximum leave-one-out embedding-distance train file per known identity plus untouched validation unknowns
protocol.channel: the untouched validation partitioned by acoustic EDA bucket
protocol.selection_guard: all thresholds and the linear score are fit only on calibration

stability.gate: non-negative Random and Hard delta on every seed; unknown recall >= 0.98

fixed_submission_candidate.threshold_source: seven-seed median plus 0.001 FP16/batch-size safety margin
